FIRST FRAME
The clip opens on the supplied first frame and stays true to it: the same faces, hair, wardrobe, place and light.

STYLE
Photorealistic live-action television drama footage, real optics and natural imperfections. Clear coverage, readable emotion, family-audience warmth.

SETTING
At the left curb outside an office building on a Colombo roadside, with the food three-wheeler farther along the same pavement.

SUBJECTS
Anudi is an adult Sri Lankan woman with medium-brown skin, an oval face, dark eyes and long black hair tied in a low ponytail, wearing a muted blue blouse, charcoal trousers and flat black shoes — Lifts her handbag onto her left forearm and takes the closed umbrella in her left hand, exits retaining the smartphone in her right hand, pushes the rear door shut with her left forearm, gives a small closed-lip nod toward the driver and begins walking screen right; The driver is an adult Sri Lankan man with medium-brown skin, short black hair and a clean-shaven face, wearing a pale grey collared shirt — Brings the car to rest and remains seated with his hands at the wheel. Hands: Anudi holds the smartphone in one hand. driver is not holding the smartphone. During the shot Anudi takes the handbag. During the shot Anudi takes the umbrella.

CAMERA
Camera: Wide shot (WIDE showing the rear passenger doorway, Anudi's full figure on exit and the route toward the office; driver visible through the front side window), eye level (eye level from pavement looking obliquely toward the curb-side rear door); 35mm lens at f/5.6, a wide-normal lens: natural perspective with some of the space around them; focus: Deep; car, pedestrian route and office frontage legible. Static: a steady, locked-off frame. As planned: locked-off on sticks throughout. Camera on side A of the line of action: the action reads left to right. Grade: Neutral overcast daylight, 6000K, Natural skin, subdued road greys and restrained colour, with gently modelled shadows..

LIGHTING
Day, window light: Overcast sky provides consistent daylight, with gentle directional falloff beneath the office frontage and car roof.

ACTION & DIALOGUE
Over 8 seconds:
0-3s: WIDE fixed on the car and pavement. The arrival transfers her attention from handset to pavement. The driver stops; Anudi loops the handbag over her left forearm and takes the closed umbrella in her left hand while retaining the phone in her right. Anudi directs her eyes to the doorway and leans forward without haste.
3-6s: WIDE fixed on the rear doorway. The doorway releases her into the ordinary street. The rear curb-side door swings open; with the door panel masking the grip, Anudi steps out and pushes it closed with her left forearm, phone still in right hand, handbag on left forearm and closed umbrella in left hand. She plants both feet before straightening and keeps the belongings gathered close to her side.
6-8s: WIDE fixed on Anudi and the car. A small acknowledgment completes the familiar drop-off. Anudi gives the seated driver a small closed-lip nod and begins walking screen right toward the office. She briefly turns her face toward the front window, dips her chin once, then redirects her eyes along the pavement.

SOUND
No dialogue. No voiceover. Nobody speaks on camera. Silence — no music, no room tone.

STYLE LOCK & CONSTRAINTS
Every person on screen who isn't the named speaker keeps their lips closed and still. The setting, casting and everyday details are Sri Lankan. Rendering constraints: Clean, unmarked frame — no watermarks, no captions, no subtitles, no UI overlay. Anatomy stays natural and consistent: hands with five fingers, stable facial features, limbs that hold their proportions through the move. Solid objects — furniture, walls, props — are impenetrable: people move around them, never through them, and every contact carries natural weight. Objects stay put unless someone deliberately moves them. Gravity behaves normally and the camera move stays smooth and singular.

FORMAT
Aspect ratio 9:16. Duration 8 seconds. Ends on a cut.
